name: session-sync
description: Coordinates sessions working on the same repo: file leases against conflicts, overlap warnings and hand-offs.

leaseMinutes.title: Lease length (minutes)
leaseMinutes.description: How long a file stays reserved for the session that edited it after that session's last activity.

leases.title: File leases
leases.description: Refuse an edit to a file another live session on the same repo is editing (the person can override with SYNC-OK).

warnings.title: Overlap warnings
warnings.description: Warn when another session changes files in the same folder, or works on the same branch with uncommitted changes.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show how many other sessions work on this repo.
